nodes.label: Logo v2 — Ornate Illustrated Badge with Chili Rooster (PNG)
nodes.description: PNG with transparent background. An alternative, more elaborate and richly illustrated version of the Chicken Time logo. Circular badge with deep crimson/burgundy red background, ornate gold decorative scrollwork border with floral/vine motifs. Bold cream/ivory uppercase 'CHICKEN' at top arc and 'TIME' at bottom arc in a serif-inflected bold font. Central clock face replaced with a textured bronze/copper dial featuring crossed spatula and fork hands, flanked by red and green chili peppers and flame motifs — emphasizing the piri piri hot food theme. Fiery orange flames ring the inner clock border. The rooster mascot is now a richly coloured cartoon cockerel with teal/green tail feathers, red comb, orange beak, holding a hot sauce bottle, wearing a white chef's hat — positioned at right. A brown leather-look ribbon banner below reads 'Piri Piri & Perfection' in cream serif italic text, with 'EST. 2024' beneath. Small red chili icons flank the banner. Overall style is highly detailed, vintage/artisan illustrative.

nodes.label: Ornate Artisan Illustrated Logo Style
nodes.description: Design concept: richly detailed, vintage/artisan illustrative style with decorative gold scrollwork, flame and chili motifs, leather-look banner, and highly coloured mascot. Used in Logo_v2.png, Logo_v3.png, public/brand-logo.png. EST. 2024 detail present.
